description:
[Deterministic public procurement algorithm. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates tender anomaly threshold and 10% wing-trimming arithmetic exclusion under Art. 110 D.Lgs 36/2023 and Annex II.2 (Method A and Method B) for public tenders awarded on lowest price criterion.
Usage: Use this tool when evaluating bidder discount offers to determine automatic exclusion or anomaly evaluation thresholds.
Returns: JSON object with { anomalyThresholdPercentage: number, trimmedOffersCount: number, anomalousOffersCount: number, methodUsed: 'METODO_A' | 'METODO_B', admittedOffers: number[], cutThresholdHigh: number, cutThresholdLow: number }.

discountPercentages.description: Array of percentage discount offers admitted (e.g. [12.5, 14.2, 10.0, 18.5, 22.1])

method.description: Calculation method from Annex II.2 (default METODO_A)

tenderBasePriceEur.description: Tender base value in EUR for absolute award calculations

name: anomalia_offerte_calculator
